text.text_excerpt: Not the best hotel as most have mentioned in their reviews. The rooms are on the smaller side with no refrigerator, microwave, safe, or view but for the price it really did its job. We really liked the location and it wasn't loud at night. It was a quick 5 minute walk to the edge of the French quarters and was located in the warehouse district with a lot of less touristy but delicious restaurants. The staff were all very courteous. I read a review noting that they charge 15 dollars for breakfast... We did not have this. It was free every morning from 6am-10am. We had a great quiet stay. Clean hotel with good friendly services. It is bit outdated, for example it does not have a restaurant but we did not care for that. The reason I chose it was its history: it's an old beautiful building that used to be a bank. They kept our luggage in the bank's old vault, I never felt so secure for my stuff:-) It is located downtown and not in the french quarter but very close to it just a 10 min walk

Stayed here 6 nights (Mon-Sun) for CSM (national physical therapy conference) last week. I shared a room with 3 other friends on the seventh floor, and the whole week there cost us about $1180 total (that's $295 per person, which is honestly really not a bad price).
